The '''28th Academy Awards''' were held on March 21, 1956, to honor the films of [[1955 in film|1955]], at the [[RKO Pantages Theatre]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]]. In this year, [[Jerry Lewis]] became the host, replacing [[Bob Hope]].<ref name="Oscars '55 Notes">
{{cite book |last1=Wallechinsky |first1=David |last2=Wallace |first2=Irving |date=1975 |title=The People's Almanac |url=https://archive.org/details/peoplesalmanac00wall/page/840/mode/2up |location=Garden City, New York |publisher=Doubleday & Company, Inc. |page=840 |isbn=0-385-04060-1}}</ref>

At just 90 minutes, ''[[Marty (film)|Marty]]'' became the shortest film to win Best Picture, as well as the second to have also won the [[Palme d'Or]] at the [[Cannes Film Festival]] (after ''[[The Lost Weekend (film)|The Lost Weekend]]'' in 1945). All of the various winners, with the exception of [[Anna Magnani]], collected their Oscars.<ref name="Oscars '55 Notes"/>

[[Grace Kelly]], soon to be [[Princess of Monaco]], attended the ceremony as a presenter on her way toward retirement from acting.<ref name="Oscars '55 Notes"/> She was chided by [[Louella Parsons]] for failing to acknowledge Lewis' tribute to her from the film business. Parsons wrote, "it seems she might have taken a moment to thank him, give him a little kiss or something before leaving the stage so abruptly."<ref name="Oscars '55 Notes"/>

For the first time in history, all four acting winners were first-time nominees.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Collins |first1=Keith |title=Oscar facts & figures |url=https://variety.com/2006/film/awards/oscar-facts-figures-1117918228/ |access-date=June 15, 2026 |work=Variety |date=February 21, 2006 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190605184741/https://variety.com/2006/film/awards/oscar-facts-figures-1117918228/ |archive-date=June 5, 2019 }}</ref>

This was the final year in which the [[Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film|Best Foreign Language Film]] was a Special/Honorary award. Beginning with the [[29th Academy Awards]], it became a competitive category.
